summary: Explore the rich historical and cultural heritage of Seoul over 7 days, visiting world-famous palaces, museums, and traditional markets.

pois.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
pois.notes: The largest of the Five Grand Palaces built during the Joseon Dynasty.

pois.name: National Folk Museum of Korea
pois.notes: Features exhibits on Korean traditional life and culture.

pois.name: Tosokchon Samgyetang (토속촌 삼계탕)
pois.notes: Famous for its ginseng chicken soup, a traditional Korean dish.

pois.name: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌한옥마을)
pois.notes: A picturesque village featuring traditional Korean hanok houses.

pois.name: Insadong (인사동)
pois.notes: A vibrant area known for its traditional arts and crafts shops.

pois.name: Changdeokgung Palace (창덕궁)
pois.notes: A UNESCO World Heritage site known for its beautiful garden.

pois.name: Jongmyo Shrine (종묘)
pois.notes: A Confucian shrine dedicated to the deceased kings and queens of the Joseon Dynasty.

pois.name: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
pois.notes: One of Korea's largest traditional markets, perfect for sampling local street food.

pois.name: Changgyeonggung Palace (창경궁)
pois.notes: Originally built as a summer palace, it is known for its beautiful botanical garden.

pois.name: National Museum of Korea
pois.notes: The largest museum in Korea, showcasing a vast collection of historical artifacts.

pois.name: War Memorial of Korea
pois.notes: A comprehensive war history museum with exhibits on Korean and international conflicts.

pois.name: Itaewon (이태원)
pois.notes: A diverse area known for its international cuisine and vibrant atmosphere.

pois.name: Namsan Seoul Tower (N서울타워)
pois.notes: An iconic landmark offering panoramic views of Seoul.

pois.name: Namdaemun Market (남대문시장)
pois.notes: The largest traditional market in Korea, known for its variety of goods.

pois.name: Deoksugung Palace (덕수궁)
pois.notes: Famous for its elegant stone-wall road and the changing of the guard ceremony.

pois.name: Myeongdong Kyoja (명동교자)
pois.notes: Known for its delicious handmade kalguksu (noodle soup).

pois.name: Myeongdong Shopping Street (명동거리)
pois.notes: A bustling area known for its shops, street food, and vibrant energy.

pois.name: Seoul Arts Center (예술의전당)
pois.notes: A comprehensive cultural complex offering a variety of performances and exhibitions.

pois.name: Seodaemun Prison History Hall (서대문형무소역사관)
pois.notes: A museum and former prison showcasing Korea's struggle for independence.

pois.name: Seoul Museum of History (서울역사박물관)
pois.notes: Explores the history of Seoul from its prehistoric times to the present.

pois.name: Cheonggyecheon Stream (청계천)
pois.notes: A serene urban renewal project offering a pleasant walkway through central Seoul.

pois.name: Gwangjang Market (광장시장)
pois.notes: Return visit for more delicious street food options.

pois.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (동대문디자인플라자)
pois.notes: A major urban development landmark known for its neo-futuristic design.

pois.name: Lotte World Tower (롯데월드타워)
pois.notes: The tallest building in Korea with an observation deck offering stunning city views.

pois.name: Bongeunsa Temple (봉은사)
pois.notes: A beautiful Buddhist temple offering a tranquil escape from the city.

pois.name: COEX Mall (코엑스몰)
pois.notes: The largest underground shopping mall in Asia, a hub for shopping and entertainment.

pois.name: Samcheong-dong (삼청동)
pois.notes: Known for its charming cafes and traditional Korean houses.

pois.name: Seoul City Wall (서울성곽)
pois.notes: Explore sections of the historic fortress wall surrounding the city.

pois.name: Dongdaemun History & Culture Park (동대문역사문화공원)
pois.notes: A modern park featuring historic ruins and cutting-edge design elements.

pois.name: Tteokbokki Town (떡볶이타운)
pois.notes: Famous for its spicy rice cake dishes, a must-try Korean street food.

pois.name: Seoul Animation Center (서울애니메이션센터)
pois.notes: Explore Korea's animation industry and enjoy interactive exhibits.
